_comment: CoreLua bridge configuration (config.json)
This file is read by bridge.py at startup. It is JSON — real comments are
not allowed, so this _comment array documents the schema. Copy this file
to config.json and edit it; the bridge validates the structure on load.
Schema:
mcpServers:  object mapping server-id -> server-spec
server-id:   a short string (e.g. "roblox", "blender"). The primary
server MUST be named "roblox" — it cannot be removed or
edited from the extension popup.
server-spec: {
command:   string (required) — the executable or script to launch.
.py files are launched via the current Python interpreter.
npx/npm/yarn commands are launched via cmd.exe /c on Windows.
args:      array of strings (optional) — command-line arguments.
env:       object of string->string (optional) — extra environment
variables for the server process.
Example with an additional Blender MCP server:
"mcpServers": {
"roblox":  { "command": "launch_studio_mcp.py", "args": [] },
"blender": { "command": "uvx", "args": ["blender-mcp"] }
The bridge validates each entry at startup. Invalid entries are skipped
with a warning in bridge_debug.log. The primary "roblox" server is
always present even if this file is missing or corrupt.
